summary: Most of the targeted R3 fixes are in place: AUTONOMOUS_SESSION §3.1 now treats C1(a/b/c) correctly and no longer excludes C1(c), the `log_negativity_channel_sdp` API docs now clearly describe `R_max_bits` as a backward-compat Choi-state proxy rather than a validated channel-level `R_max`, the AD γ>1/2 wording is aligned between PHASE_STATUS and PHASE1_REPORT, and I did not find a new channel-vs-state silent upgrade in the touched material. The patch still has minor documentation residue, so it is not ready for PASS yet.

issues.description: The claimed v0.5 -> v0.7 propagation across summary docs is incomplete. `PHASE_STATUS.md` still refers to `upper_bound_report.md v0.5` in both the Sub-Q3 completion summary and the output inventory, and `AUTONOMOUS_SESSION_2026-04-24_FINAL.md` still says `upper_bound_report v0.5` in the Day 4 chronology. That means the requested cleanup of stale v0.5 references is not fully done.
issues.suggestion: Update the remaining summary-doc references to `v0.7`, or, if the AUTONOMOUS_SESSION line is intentionally a historical commit label, annotate it explicitly as historical so it is not read as the current report version.

issues.description: `AUTONOMOUS_SESSION_2026-04-24_FINAL.md` now says in §3.1 that the AD-Q item already has `C1 = ✅ (c)` and that these rows are missing only C2, but the R0.2 status table in §4 still lists `AD Q for γ ≤ 1/2` as `C1 = ⏳ 等用户 paper-level`. The new §3.1 table itself is fine, but the document no longer gives a consistent per-item C1/C2/C3 status for that conclusion.
issues.suggestion: Harmonize the §4 status-table row with the §3.1 ruling. Either mark AD-Q as `C1 = ✅ (c)` there as well, or downgrade the §3.1 wording if you intend paper-level validation to remain required for that item.

round_recommendation: Update the remaining stale `upper_bound_report` version references and reconcile the AD-Q C1 status within `AUTONOMOUS_SESSION_2026-04-24_FINAL.md`, then rerun review; the docstring and AD γ>1/2 wording look ready.
